canonical_state.health_contract: GREEN core and provenance, empty validation and provenance exceptions, valid transaction lineage

workbook_role: Durable history, context and human-readable reporting; never a substitute for newer valid Sleeper state.

translations.continuous_operation: Treat all GFO chats as one Big Nasty operation governed by shared doctrine, current Sleeper state and the GFO ledger.
translations.semantic_authority: Sleeper controls platform-recorded ownership, availability, roster placement, FAAB and picks at its timestamp; Grant controls intent and corrections.
translations.temporal_alignment: Current roster state controls present ownership at its timestamp while transaction lineage explains historical changes at their effective times.
translations.retrieval_vs_uncertainty: Retain the newest successful GREEN Sleeper state when retrieval fails; label freshness limits without reopening settled facts.
translations.canonical_state_first: Read the GFO manifest, diff, snapshot and transaction lineage from gfo-green before workflow diagnostics or ad hoc reconstruction.
translations.state_evaluation_separation: Resolve ownership, active, taxi, reserve, FAAB, picks and source health before evaluating football talent or move quality.
translations.availability_proof: A player is available only when absent from every current Sleeper roster, taxi and reserve list; otherwise name the owner or mark availability unconfirmed.
translations.layered_evaluation: Translate production, role, health, talent and market value through superflex full-PPR scoring, age, depth chart, draft capital, FAAB, taxi and reserve rules.
translations.discovery_vs_urgency: Balance early asymmetric-upside signals against active, taxi and reserve pressure, defense streaming, exact drop and FAAB cost.
translations.executable_recommendations: Include exact drop, FAAB range and active, taxi, reserve or IR mechanism, plus any draft-pick or defense-slot effect.
translations.state_lineage_identity: Resolve transaction players from authoritative Sleeper IDs, preserve transaction lineage and validate deterministic FAAB history against current state.
translations.roster_optionality: Keep worthwhile reserve, IR and taxi optionality filled while integrating weekly defense-streaming constraints.
translations.post_move_writeback: Update the GFO ledger, confirmed overrides, roster overlay, FAAB, slots and Sleeper reconciliation after each confirmed move.
translations.actionable_monitoring: Prioritize Big Nasty players, verified available adds, handcuff or role effects and realistic trade targets.
translations.cross_sport_propagation: Apply shared organizational lessons through football rules, data, schedules, market and roster mechanics; never import baseball state.
translations.lean_architecture: Keep Sleeper collection, validation, lineage projection and interpretation as separate single-owner responsibilities with thin orchestration.
translations.durability_versioning: Use the latest valid Sleeper canonical state and latest shared doctrine; retain older workbooks and snapshots as historical evidence only.
